+def filter_users(expression: str) -> list[dict]:
+    import ast
+    import operator
+    
+    users = store.get_all()
+    
+    operators = {
+        ast.Eq: operator.eq,
+        ast.NotEq: operator.ne,
+        ast.Lt: operator.lt,
+        ast.LtE: operator.le,
+        ast.Gt: operator.gt,
+        ast.GtE: operator.ge,
+        ast.And: lambda a, b: a and b,
+        ast.Or: lambda a, b: a or b,
+        ast.Not: operator.not_,
+    }
+
+    def _eval(node, user):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+            return node.value
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+            return user.get(node.id)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+            left = _eval(node.left, user)
+            for op, comparator in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
+                right = _eval(comparator, user)
+                if not operators[type(op)](left, right):
+                    return False
+                left = right
+            return True
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+            values = [_eval(v, user) for v in node.values]
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+                return all(values)
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+                return any(values)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+                return not _eval(node.operand, user)
+        return False
+
+    tree = ast.parse(expression, mode='eval').body
+    
+    result = []
+    for user in users:
+        if _eval(tree, user):
+            result.append(user)
